filing_office: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations, State Records and Uniform Commercial Code
filing_fee_notes: Articles filing only. The Certificate of Publication costs an additional 50, plus newspaper charges that vary.
registered_agent_rules: The LLC must designate the Secretary of State as agent for service of process and supply a forwarding address. The false value refers to an additional separately appointed registered agent.
expedite_options: Additional fees: 25 for 24-hour handling, excluding nonbusiness days; 75 for same-business-day requests by noon; 150 for two-hour hand-delivered or faxed requests by 2:30 p.m. Biennial Statements cannot be expedited.
annual_report_due: During the calendar month of formation, every two years, starting two years after formation.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Certain LLCs owe a separate annual filing fee using Form IT-204-LL. Applicability depends on tax classification and New York-source activity; a qualifying disregarded LLC pays 25. The fee is due on the 15th day of the third month after tax-year end, adjusted for weekends and legal holidays.
publication_requirement: Most LLCs must publish in two county-clerk-designated newspapers for six consecutive weeks and file a Certificate of Publication with publisher affidavits within 120 days after formation. The certificate filing fee is 50; newspaper costs vary.
state_tax_registration_agency: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
unemployment_insurance_agency: New York State Department of Labor
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization, adopt a written operating agreement and complete the publication process. File a Biennial Statement every two years.
common_mistake: Do not confuse the Biennial Statement with the separate annual tax filing fee.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Standard processing time was not confirmed. Adopt the written operating agreement before, at formation, or within 90 days afterward; it is internal and not filed with DOS. DOS references a publication exception under Arts and Cultural Affairs Law Section 23.03. The tax entry describes the separate annual filing fee using the published 2025 instructions; corporate-tax elections require different analysis. The online formation URL is DOS's official gateway.
